cream-parchment.$description: Cream Parchment — Page canvas, section backgrounds, card surfaces, nav bar fill — the warm off-white that defines the entire mood and replaces what would normally be pure white

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Elevated card surfaces, video embed containers, contrast panels against the cream canvas

bark-brown.$description: Bark Brown — Primary text, all borders, nav links, body copy, headings — replaces black throughout the system, giving every line a warm ink-like quality

warm-gray.$description: Warm Gray — Secondary text, subtle borders, nav dividers — the mid-tone that bridges Bark Brown headings and lighter dividers

stone.$description: Stone — Hairline dividers, image borders, subtle separators between sections

driftwood.$description: Driftwood — Input field borders, form element outlines

earth.$description: Earth — Secondary headings, muted label text

light-stone.$description: Light Stone — Lightest border tone, disabled states, subtle structure lines

ink.$description: Ink — Input text color, high-contrast form text — the only context where true black appears

deep-teal.$description: Deep Teal — Primary action buttons, filled CTAs — the single chromatic fill color permitted for interactive moments, creating quiet authority against the cream

aubergine.$description: Aubergine — Decorative card borders, heading accent strokes, editorial highlight containers

iris.$description: Iris — Decorative card borders, accent strokes on data containers

cobalt.$description: Cobalt — Link accents, decorative borders on blue-themed content blocks

ice-blue.$description: Ice Blue — Input field backgrounds, soft highlight washes on data rows, subtle surface tint

saffron.$description: Saffron — Occasional button accent for editorial highlight CTAs

amber.$description: Amber — Occasional button accent for warm-themed CTAs

neue-haas-grotesk-display.$description: Primary typeface for all headings, body copy, nav, and UI text — the premium editorial grotesque that carries the entire interface. Weight 400 for display headlines creates a whisper rather than a shout; weight 600 for subheadings and emphasis; weight 700 reserved for section labels and small-caps headers

neue-haas-grotesk-text.$description: Secondary typeface for small utility text, nav micro-copy, fine print — slightly more compact than the Display variant for 10–12px sizes

font-awesome-5-brands.$description: Font Awesome 5 Brands — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
